chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who circumambulated the House three and a half circuits, then found the House empty, so he entered it. What should he do? He said: 'He must repeat his circumambulation, for he went against the Sunnah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person stops their tawaf at a half circuit?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that stopping at a half-point during circumambulation invalidates the circuit, requiring a full restart to maintain the integrity of the ritual. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on precision in the physical components of worship, ensuring that the *tawaf* aligns strictly with the established *Sunnah* of completing distinct, whole circuits around the Kaaba. The deviation is not merely technical but signifies a departure from the prophetic model of worship, necessitating renewal of the act.
